scripts.protocol:manifest: cargo run --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p o-sfu-protocol --bin o-sfu-protocol-manifest && prettier --write --ignore-path /dev/null src/generated/protocol_manifest.json
scripts.lint: npm run protocol:manifest && eslint src scripts test playwright eslint.config.mjs
scripts.build: npm run protocol:manifest && npm run wasm:build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run wasm:check-size
scripts.build:odoo: npm run protocol:manifest && npm run wasm:build && npm run wasm:check-size && node ./scripts/build_odoo_bundle.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run build:odoo && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:odoo && playwright test
